title: About Our Institution
introduction: Our institution is dedicated to providing quality education and comprehensive support to children with special needs. Since its recognition under the Government Grant-in-Aid Scheme on 26 September 2003, the school has consistently worked towards academic excellence, holistic development, and social inclusion.
mission: To empower children with special needs through specialized education, therapeutic support, and inclusive opportunities that enable them to lead independent and dignified lives.
vision: To be a center of excellence in special education by fostering a nurturing environment, professional expertise, and community collaboration.
objectives: Provide structured and specialized educational programs.
Promote holistic development including academic, physical, and social growth.
Offer medical, counseling, and rehabilitation support services.
Guide parents in accessing government schemes and welfare benefits.
Encourage community awareness and inclusion of persons with disabilities.

staff.teaching: Three professionally trained teachers holding D.S.C. (M.R.) qualifications.
staff.medicalSupport: One paramedical officer and one honorary medical officer.
staff.supportStaff: One caregiver, one cleaner, and one peon to ensure a safe and hygienic environment.

facilities: Free medical consultation and health support.
Guidance on government concessions and pension schemes.
Support for T.C.R. surgeries and financial aid coordination.
Government welfare and rehabilitation scheme guidance.
